contexts: seven-practice primary care network with four link workers
no funding and no new patient data
reading: The confusion in the literature has a structure: reviews overlap heavily and positive conclusions rest on a few small uncontrolled evaluations (claim c3). The service-use benefit comes from non-randomised comparisons (claim c1) and loneliness shows no clear effect (claim c2). Mechanisms explain why people with complex needs may benefit less (claim c4). An umbrella review that counts primary studies once and appraises each review is what the commissioning board needs.
